amberwake-basin.name: Amberwake Basin
amberwake-basin.description: Competitive migration playtest: mirrored 1v1 bases, four-node amber sites, opening timber and guarded expansions. Economy and save continuation verified; route pacing and wider opening balance are still being tuned.

amberwake-wilds.name: Amberwake Wilds
amberwake-wilds.description: A two-player woodland showcase on the competitive Amberwake layout. Build on clear colony shelves, scout around the lake, and fight for amber and Root beneath old watches, giant oaks and hollow logs. Four-node sites and mirrored starts follow the competitive foundation; wider balance remains a playtest.
